findings.issue: MANIFEST files declarations are silently treated as an empty product inventory
findings.counterexample: With no candidate_products, keep MANIFEST bytes fixed and change declared compute.py after next_packet(review_only=True). Context remains equal, next returns same packet, acknowledge accepts, record completes. products_sha256 control rejects the same pre-ACK change.
findings.scope: Automatic review-only product freshness. Actual SMICA byte drift is not asserted.

findings.issue: Review outcome recording has no on-disk candidate freshness check
findings.counterexample: For supported products_sha256, acknowledge valid candidate, change declared compute.py without changing manifest, then record matching candidate_identity success; task becomes completed.
findings.scope: ACK-to-record review boundary; independent reviewer can separately verify content, but controller does not enforce it.

other_bound_mechanisms.manifest_hash: Binds declared hashes, not actual referenced files; this is sufficient only when a consumer checks the declared hashes.
other_bound_mechanisms.source_contracts: Bind input JSON, not omitted candidate files.
other_bound_mechanisms.history_receipt: The review recording path hashes the new review receipt and compares candidate identity strings; it does not validate historical candidate file bytes.
other_bound_mechanisms.one_writer_read_only_instructions: Reduce expected change risk but do not provide byte freshness. Actual independent source/product checking remains usable task-specific evidence.

provenance_overhead.measurement_source: Parent-reported accepted acquisition checkpoint measurement, not repeated by reviewer

later_improvement_scope: Justified later investigation: split task-local input/candidate freshness from disjoint dormant acquisition payload validation. Continue exact source/receipt/binding checks; amortize bulk payload reads only when a real immutable snapshot or explicitly enforced no-writer ownership epoch provides equivalent continuity. Rehash all relevant payload at handoff/resume/consumption or ownership change. A size/mtime cache alone is insufficient. No source change, repair authorization, new gate, or original acceptance change is proposed by this diagnostic.
limits: Actual packet/manifest read only; all mutations tiny external fixture files and in-memory synthetic state. No actual candidate/STATE edits, GB hashing, production network/process operation, science rerun, or admission decision.
